purpose: One bounded development diagnostic for a single simple exact4D benchmark below90%; not a final benchmark or precise population estimate.
scope: Dictionary dhatu plus exactly lakara/prayoga/purusha/vacana; no added derivation, prefixes or independently selected pada. All VP accepted gold alternatives preserved.

cells.label: short_adanta_non_aorist
cells.predicate: Curadi citation ends in literal non-nasal a; remove that a and require the penultimate remaining phoneme in SLP1 aiufx, followed by a consonant. Kartari, non-Lun, current shared and local source exclusions.
cells.selection: Every eligible development family exactly8 times, each in8 distinct non-aorist tenses.

cells.label: other_adanta_aorist
cells.predicate: Other literal-a-final Curadi citations, Kartari Lun, current shared and local source exclusions.
cells.selection: Every eligible development family once; the uncertain sUca aorist is excluded uniformly.

cells.label: broad_non_curadi
cells.predicate: Current-policy classical dictionary entries outside Curadi, Kartari; current shared and local exclusions.
cells.selection: One task per family, all9 remaining classes, exactly8 per tense; independent seeded controls with no outcome filter.

forecast.status: Conditional transport of small historical16k cells; not a measured or calibrated forecast.

cell_rates.broad_non_curadi: 1.0 planning assumption from recent easy probes

assumptions: Accuracy rates transfer across new tuples and 16k to64k; unproven.
Mixture deliberately concentrates60% in Curadi;104/200 questions use only13 families.

predeclared_decision.advance_exploration: All-request AND usable accuracy below90%, with source-supported errors across at least5 families. Review refusals/truncations and gold disputes before interpretation. This only motivates larger validation.
predeclared_decision.close_this_mixture: Accuracy>=90% or apparent difficulty explained by unresolved gold/format issues means this bounded mixture does not provide the desired signal.
predeclared_decision.no_final_qualification: 200 development tasks cannot certify top-model ordering, sub1pp sampling error, independent held-out performance or general Sanskrit coverage.

reporting: All-request and usable accuracy; refusals, truncations and missing-answer bounds.
iid and unstratified family-sandwich SE plus family-bootstrap interval; all cells, tense and class breakdowns.
Raw frozen results preserved; any grammatical exclusion applies uniformly by predicate to success and failure, reported additively.

family_supply.source: Dictionary/family-split census with current scope; no held-out model answers read.
family_supply.scale_limit: Keeping52% of a1000-question benchmark in short-adanta would place520 questions across just14 test families, averaging37.1 each. This is a serious independent-family and RL-generalization bottleneck; repeated forms do not create sub1pp independent precision.
